# Zillow.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/zillow-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/zillow-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects property data from Zillow.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Zillow Real Estate Property Data in Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-zillow)
- **Code:** [`zillow.py`](zillow.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Property pages](results/property.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Zillow search for finding property listings
- Zillow property pages for property datasets

## Functions

- `scrape_search(url, max_scrape_pages=None)` → `List[dict]`: base search function which is used by sale and rent search functions
- `scrape_properties(urls)`: scrape zillow property pages for property data

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

## Output

- [`results/property.json`](results/property.json): `zpid`, `palsId`, `stateId`, `countyId`, `cityId`, `country`, `isNonOwnerOccupied`, `propertyHasLasViolation`, `photoCount`, `hdpTypeDimension`, `listingTypeDimension`, `rentalMarketingTreatments`, `contactAgentFormVariant`, `taxAssessedValue`, `description`, `topNavJson`, `city`, `state`, `streetAddress`, `zipcode`, `homeStatus`, `homeType`, `isListingClaimedByCurrentSignedInUser`, `isCurrentSignedInAgentResponsible`, `isCurrentSignedInUserVerifiedOwner`, `moveHomeMapLocationLink`, `propertyUpdatePageLink`, `editPropertyHistorylink`, `propertyEventLogLink`, `isVerifiedClaimedByCurrentSignedInUser`, `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `livingAreaValue`, `livingAreaUnitsShort`, `address`, `attributionInfo`, `listing_sub_type`, `responsivePhotos`, `isPremierBuilder`, `price`, … (85 more)
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `zpid`, `palsId`, `id`, `rawHomeStatusCd`, `marketingStatusSimplifiedCd`, `imgSrc`, `hasImage`, `detailUrl`, `statusType`, `statusText`, `countryCurrency`, `price`, `unformattedPrice`, `address`, `addressStreet`, `addressCity`, `addressState`, `addressZipcode`, `isUndisclosedAddress`, `shouldShowRequestOnPrice`, `beds`, `baths`, `area`, `latLong`, `isZillowOwned`, `flexFieldText`, `contentType`, `hdpData`, `isUserClaimingOwner`, `isUserConfirmedClaim`, `pgapt`, `sgapt`, `zestimate`, `shouldShowZestimateAsPrice`, `has3DModel`, `hasVideo`, `isHomeRec`, `hasAdditionalAttributions`, `isFeaturedListing`, `isShowcaseListing`, … (6 more)

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`zillow.py`](zillow.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/zillow-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_search_scraping`, `test_property_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
